verdict.rationale: Convex documents that its MCP server is restricted from accessing production deployments by default as a safety measure, which is a limited form of least-privilege scoping for AI agents, but there is no broader mechanism for issuing configurable, scoped API credentials/tokens for agents beyond this single hardcoded restriction. missing for 10: documented API key/token scoping system, granular permission grants, ability to customize or extend the restriction beyond the binary prod/dev split.
